run_LiteLLM_subprocess: run the LiteLLM proxy as a background subprocess with a YAML config file on a specified host and port
get_LiteLLM_models: get the list of available models from the running LiteLLM proxy server via the /v1/models endpoint
pipe_chat_completions: pipe chat messages to the LiteLLM proxy and get streaming or non-streaming chat completion responses
create_LiteLLM_config: create a default LiteLLM config YAML file with general_settings, litellm_settings, model_list, and router_settings sections
update_LiteLLM_valves: update the pipeline valves and restart the LiteLLM background process with the new configuration
